name: Steph Scott
researchKeywords: marginalisation and stigma, justice-involved families, young people, vaccine inequalities
bio: Steph Scott is a Senior Lecturer in Public Health and Qualitative Methods. She is an interdisciplinary social scientist whose work spans applied public health, sociology and criminology.
researchFocus: Steph studies marginalisation, stigma and health inequalities, particularly among justice-involved families, young people, vulnerable populations and people experiencing multiple and complex needs. Her current work includes young people's experiences of COVID-19, children with an incarcerated family member, vaccine inequalities, prison food environments, food insecurity among people with severe mental illness, and first-time perpetrators of domestic abuse.
